notablePrerequisites:
Genesis Chamber is untapped.
You control at least one nontoken artifact creature.
description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing any nontoken artifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
The creature enters the battlefield, triggering Genesis Chamber, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Myr, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
